THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REED-REED.0-0r.ancien: In the end, you're nothing more than a "shadow"...
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REED-REED.0-1r.char: That's a past I can never leave behind. But it's also the spark that lights the road ahead.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REED-REED.1-0r.ancien: You have no need for that spear anymore? It would make a fine addition to my collection. A reminder of all those futile efforts.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REED-REED.1-1r.char: It doesn't suit me anymore. But I'd rather see it standing as a flagpole out in the fields than rotting away in this tower.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REED-REED.2-0r.ancien: Flames. Purple flames. Who lit that fire for you?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REED-REED.2-1r.char: ...I hope you "enjoy" the feeling. Just as I did, once.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REED-REED.3-0r.ancien: Such dull convictions. Such hopeless ideals. Will your people bow to you?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REED-REED.3-1r.char: I won't be a monarch. And Tara doesn't need one anymore.
